### get_notes

```python
project_task.get_notes(queryfilter: dict = None, sort: Optional[str] = None, max_results: Optional[int] = None) -> List[dict]
```

Retrieve the notes of the current project task.

- `queryfilter`: Optional filter parameters (e.g. created_at, medium, person)
- `sort`: Optional order, e.g. '-created_at' for the newest note first (default: ascending by id)
- `max_results`: Return at most this many notes, fetching only the pages needed (default: all)
- Returns: List of notes

API: `GET /project_tasks/{id}/notes`

### add_note

Add a note to the current project task.

- `note`: Note text, or a dictionary with the note data (e.g. text, suppress_note_added_notifications)
- Returns: The note that was added

API: `POST /project_tasks/{id}/notes`
